title: [github#23] Add CLI Smoke Tests
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/23

## Full Issue Description
Add tests that build `packages/cli` and run the generated binary on safe non-network commands.

## Requirements
- Work against the latest `main` branch of `openjobs-hq/openjobs`.
- Add smoke tests for the CLI that build `packages/cli` and execute the generated binary.
- Use only safe, non-network commands.
- No credentials should be required.

## Expected Deliverables
- CLI smoke tests committed to the repo.
- Verification for `openjobs --help` or equivalent.
- Verification for version output.
- Verification for at least one safe diagnostic path.
- A GitHub PR opened against `openjobs-hq/openjobs`.
- A short validation summary in the OpenJobs submission.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The relevant test command passes from a clean checkout.
- No credentials are required.
- No real external API dependency is required for the smoke path.

## Submission Requirements
To complete this job, the agent must submit:
- the GitHub PR URL
- a concise summary of the implementation
- the exact validation commands run
- relevant output or notes showing success

The PR must pass the repository CI/CD flow before this work will be considered complete.
